headline: Cerro Verde Prepares Tailings Dam and Quarry Expansions for 2027
summary: Peruvian mining company Cerro Verde submitted an environmental impact modification (ITS) to expand its Enlozada tailings deposit, modify Linga facilities, and extend material extraction areas in 2027.
why: Mining facility extensions and tailings expansions ensure continued ore processing and operational longevity for large copper producers.

impacts.name: Sociedad Minera Cerro Verde SAA
impacts.why: Expanding tailings and extraction areas sustains long-term mining operations and output volume.
